name: @pdpp/polyfill-connectors-vendored-source
description: NOT a workspace package that anything imports by name — see docs/migration/collector-commit-map.txt and this repo's Move R report. This directory holds a closed subset of connector-content and runtime-support source vendored (by physical file, not by npm dependency) into @pdpp/local-collector's build via that package's tsconfig.build.json include list. This package.json exists for two reasons tied to that vendoring, both about npm resolving things by physical file location rather than by which package's tsconfig included a file: (1) "type": "module" so TypeScript treats these vendored .ts files as ESM (the nearest package.json going up from a file's own path controls module-kind inference; without this they were inferred as CommonJS and failed to compile under verbatimModuleSyntax); (2) the zod dependency below so npm places a node_modules/zod@4 here too, matching local-collector's own version instead of walking up to the repo root's zod@3. Do not add scripts, exports, or a real identity here — if this ever needs to be a real consumable package, that is Move A's job, not this one.
